key_reasoning.reason: Diffstat shows 9 files changed (403 insertions, 6 deletions) across constants/, utils/, hooks/, components/markdown/tokens/, and pages/workflows/components/ plus their __tests__ subdirectories.

New flag infrastructure (FEATURE_FLAGS.MERMAID constant, isMermaidEnabled util, useMermaidEnabled hook) plus two independent consumers gated on it: MermaidDiagram.tsx (chat rendering) and WorkflowFormFields.tsx (workflow diagram preview, including a mid-request race-condition guard added in a follow-up commit).

Closest existing pattern is the isFeatureEnabled/useFeatureFlag pair used by ~25 other flags in constants/featureFlags.ts, all of which default to disabled. isMermaidEnabled/useMermaidEnabled deliberately invert that default (fail-open: enabled unless config explicitly sets enabled === false) for backward compatibility with older backends — a genuine divergence from the established pattern, compounded by the added isMermaidAvailableRef guard in WorkflowFormFields.tsx to discard a stale diagram if the flag flips mid-request. No security or persistence surface is touched (DOMPurify sanitization of the Mermaid SVG output was already in place and is unchanged).
